short: A civil war fought by a man who believed he was the younger brother of Jesus.
full:
Hong Xiuquan failed the provincial examinations four times. After the second attempt he suffered a prolonged illness and visions which, read alongside a Christian tract he had been given, convinced him he was God's second son and Jesus's younger brother, sent to destroy demons. His God Worshipping Society drew tens of thousands of Hakka villagers and miners in Guangxi, and on 11 January 1851 he proclaimed the Heavenly Kingdom of Great Peace at Jintian. In March 1853 the Taiping took Nanjing and made it their capital.

They held much of the Yangtze valley for a decade, banning opium, foot-binding and private property in theory while a murderous power struggle among their kings gutted the leadership in 1856. The Qing regular armies were useless; the war was won instead by provincial gentry forces, above all Zeng Guofan's Xiang Army, with a foreign-officered contingent in support. Hong died in June 1864 and Nanjing fell on 19 July. Estimates of the dead run to twenty million or more, making it the deadliest civil war recorded anywhere.
